definition: Wishing harm or evil to others.
author: Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra
quote: Don Quixote offered to mount guard over the castle lest they should be attacked by some giant or other malevolent scoundrel, covetous of the great treasure of beauty the castle contained.
example_sentence: The cat watched the pigeons with malevolent interest.
